title: Cheese and Jalapeño Nachos
summary: Salted tortilla chips are spread on two trays, each topped with grated cheese and a jalapeño slice, sprinkled with brine and baked hot for 5-7 minutes until bubbling.

ingredients.item: mild Cheddar or Colby, coarsely grated

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C with racks in the upper and lower thirds.

steps.title: Spread the chips
steps.text: Lay the chips in a single layer on two trays.

steps.title: Top each chip
steps.text: Press a scant tablespoon of cheese onto each chip and add 1-2 jalapeño slices.

steps.title: Add brine
steps.text: Sprinkle the jalapeño brine over the top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 5-7 minutes, swapping the trays halfway, until melted and lightly browned.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve straight away while the cheese is molten.

tips: Thick, sturdy chips hold the topping without going soggy.
Grate your own cheese; pre-grated melts less smoothly.
Add refried beans under the cheese for a heartier plate.
storage: Best eaten hot from the oven. Nachos do not reheat well. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
